responsibility: Implements diagnostic reporting for borrow-check failures after Polonius analysis has run on a BIR function. It translates Polonius move, loan, and subset-origin error tuples back into source-facing GCC rich_location diagnostics by decoding CFG points into BIR statements, resolving loans and lifetime parameters from the function’s place and region maps, deduplicating repeated subset errors, and emitting multi-label messages such as moved-value, borrowed-value, and missing-lifetime-constraint reports.
same_name_distinction: Within the rust-borrow-checker-diagnostics pair, this .cc file is the implementation side that performs error translation, deduplication, statement/loan/origin lookups, and rich_location emission, while the header only declares the BorrowCheckerDiagnostics API and the data it consumes.
